mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS visitId, f.patient_basic_info_id AS patientId, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate, f.doctor_id AS doctorId, u.name AS doctorName, f.bsbq, f.fzjc, f.bqpg, f.zyzd, f.zlfa, f.blsj, f.bblsj FROM patient_follow_up_history f LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = f.doctor_id WHERE f.id = #{visitId} AND f.research_type NOT IN () AND f.patient_basic_info_id IN (SELECT r.patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor r WHERE r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND r.research_type NOT IN ())

SELECT f.id FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id = #{patientId} AND f.research_type NOT IN () ORDER BY COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) IS NULL, COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), f.id LIMIT 1
